user.title: PRE TOU Setup
user.description: Select your TOU ID shown on your PRE electricity meter (e.g. TD25_001). The integration includes pre-loaded PRE distribution schedules. Optionally, you can paste a custom CSV table.

data.enable_relays: Create entities for appliance relays (Relay 1 and Relay 2)
data.custom_csv: Custom CSV table (optional, leave empty for built-in PRE schedule)

error.invalid_csv: The provided CSV table has an invalid format or contains no valid TOU entries.
error.unknown_tou_id: Selected TOU ID was not found in the database.

abort.already_configured: This TOU entry is already configured in Home Assistant.
